build_backbone: build a pretrained ResNet50 backbone model from torchvision with optional checkpoint loading
generate_carriers: generate k random orthonormal watermark carrier vectors of dimension d and save to file
load_messages: load watermark messages from a text file as binary tensors with bit or string encoding
cosine_pvalue: compute the p-value for a cosine similarity threshold between random unit vectors in d dimensions
parse_params: parse a comma-separated parameter string like SGD,lr=0.01 into a dictionary with float values
